newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds struggle to break range, eye 101.25.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds struggle to break range, eye 101.25.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will aim for 101.25 on Tuesday if they can decisively break their recent range, technical analysts said.

"Although there is some slightly bullish potential due to the bull candle from yesterday, the market is still in a very small range," Nico Bakker, inter-market technical analyst at ABN-AMRO Bank in Amsterdam, said.
Bakker said Bunds were largely confined to a range of 100.40 to 100.85, although they managed to pop above that in early trade. Bunds were quoted at 100.92 at 0656 GMT, up 0.15 in the session.
Bakker said if the contract managed to hold its gains it would push for 101.25, a 38.2 percent retracement of the rally from the April low of 99.05 to the May high of 102.59.
Bakker said a 61.8 percent retracement of the same move gives support this session at 100.40.
"Below 100.40, 99.00 comes in," Bakker said, but he expected the first level to hold.
Technical analysts at SBC Warburg in London said breaking out of the 100.40-101.00 range will give on the upside a mid-channel line at 101.40.
